declarations.name: BlockquoteControllerRxjs

members.name: value
members.description: Latest value emitted by the stream (or `initialValue`).

members.name: error
members.description: Last error emitted by the stream, `undefined` otherwise.

members.name: completed
members.description: `true` once the current stream has completed.

members.name: callback
members.description: Called with every new (distinct) value emitted by the stream.

members.name: onError
members.description: Called when the stream errors (falls back to `globalThis.reportError`).

members.name: stream$
members.description: The current Observable. Assigning a different one re-subscribes.

members.name: subscribed
members.description: `true` while there is an active subscription.

members.name: subscribe
members.description: Subscribes to `stream$`. No-op if already subscribed.

members.name: unsubscribe
members.description: Aborts the current subscription, if any.
